notes.title: Patch Notes v1.01
notes.content:
Bug Fixes
[list]
[*] Fixed the phenomenon of resetting achievements that have already been obtained when achieving an achievement and then obtaining them.
[*] Fixed an issue where the 'Bounce Master' achievement was obtained when clearing 4-6 instead of 4-5
[/list]

tags.bug: - Fixed the phenomenon of resetting achievements that have already been obtained when achieving an achievement and then obtaining them.
- Fixed an issue where the 'Bounce Master' achievement was obtained when clearing 4-6 instead of 4-5
